method: Original frozen model mean token log likelihood. Direct scores diagnosis given case; channel scores exact observed case given candidate diagnosis. Uniform candidate priors, fixed initial-pool tie break.
controls: Both directions share the same retained original documents, common record-completion instructions and fixed4 candidate pool; 4 score calls each. Existing49 calibrated and list8 controls also reported.
context_change: Original diagnostic system/answer contract replaced by identical clinical-record completion instruction in both arms; original retrieved documents retained verbatim. Channel removes patient from conditioning prefix and scores it as target, rather than copying it from context.
scope: Same40 exposed R3 diagnosis cases per original backbone M4/M5. Frozen6-call candidate front reused. No training examples, gold, other endpoint, model weight update or new retrieval.
expansion: Require credible net gain across both backbones over direct scoring and current calibrated candidate before expansion. No disease-specific prompt or mixing-weight selection.
runtime: Prompt logprobs over actual continuation tokens; prefix caching disabled to obtain every prompt score. One unused generated token per scoring call is retained and counted.
failure: All160 direct requests per backbone used noncanonical split tokenization at a trailing space; channel0. Changed field separators to newline and require full-string tokenization equality.
